name: labs/basf__pytem
title: BASF pyTEM TEM interface (pyTEM.Interface.Interface)
intro: BASF pyTEM TEM interface (pyTEM.Interface.Interface), adapted from basf/pytem. It reads `stage_home`, `beam_blanked`, `screen_position`, `column_valve_position` and 5 more; sets `stage_x`, `stage_y`, `stage_z`, `stage_alpha` and 1 more; runs `reset_stage_position` and `enter_safe_state`. `reset_stage_position`: reset the stage to x=y=z=alpha=beta=0 (the native reset_stage_position). A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/basf__pytem --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/basf__pytem --backend fake --mcp
